User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account in the GearShare campus marketplace, including their profile information and reputation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

fullName.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The user's primary email address, used for login and communication.

profilePhotoUrl.description: URL to the user's profile photo.

trustScore.description: A reputation score (out of 5) for the user, derived from transaction history and reviews.

memberSince.description: The date and time when the user joined the platform.

pointsBalance.description: Current points balance for referral rewards.

receiveTransactionNotifications.description: Indicates if the user wishes to receive notifications for transaction updates (e.g., request approved/rejected).

receiveMessageNotifications.description: Indicates if the user wishes to receive notifications for new messages.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a predefined category for items available in the marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The name of the category (e.g., Books, Calculator, Laptop).

iconUrl.description: URL to an icon representing the category.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: Represents an item listed by a user for borrowing in the marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Item entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns and listed this item. (Relationship: User 1:N Item)

categoryId.description: Reference to the Category this item belongs to. (Relationship: Category 1:N Item)

name.description: The name or title of the item.

description.description: A detailed description of the item, potentially AI-generated or assisted.

photoUrls.description: An array of URLs to photos of the item.

condition.description: The physical condition of the item (e.g., 'Excellent', 'Good', 'Fair').

pricePerDay.description: The rental price of the item per day in local currency (INR).

isFree.description: Indicates if the item is offered for free (true) or has a rental price (false).

pickupLocationAddress.description: The physical address where the item can be picked up and returned.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the item's pickup location.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the item's pickup location.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the item listed.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the item listing was last updated.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a borrow request and its lifecycle from initiation to completion, including secure exchange details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

itemId.description: Reference to the Item being borrowed in this transaction. (Relationship: Item 1:N Transaction)

borrowerId.description: Reference to the User who is borrowing the item. (Relationship: User 1:N Transaction)

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns and is lending the item. (Relationship: User 1:N Transaction)

requestedStartDate.description: The requested start date for borrowing the item.

requestedEndDate.description: The requested end date for borrowing the item.

status.description: The current status of the transaction (e.g., 'Pending', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'PickedUp', 'Returned', 'Completed').

requestDate.description: The date and time when the borrow request was initiated.

approvalDate.description: The date and time when the owner approved the request.

actualPickupDate.description: The actual date and time when the item was picked up.

actualReturnDate.description: The actual date and time when the item was returned.

pickupCode.description: A unique verification code generated for secure item pickup.

totalRentalPrice.description: The total calculated rental price for the transaction, if applicable.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a review given by a user about an item or another user following a transaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Review entity.

transactionId.description: Reference to the Transaction this review is associated with. (Relationship: Transaction 1:N Review)

reviewerId.description: Reference to the User who wrote this review. (Relationship: User 1:N Review)

reviewedUserId.description: Reference to the User being reviewed (e.g., the item owner if written by borrower, or borrower if by owner). (Relationship: User 1:N Review)

itemId.description: Reference to the Item that was part of the transaction being reviewed. (Relationship: Item 1:N Review)

rating.description: The star rating given in the review (1 to 5).

comment.description: The textual content of the review.

reviewDate.description: The date and time when the review was submitted.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a private message thread between two users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Conversation entity.

participantUserIds.description: An array of two User IDs participating in this conversation. (Relationship: User N:N Conversation)

itemId.description: Optional: Reference to an Item if the conversation is related to a specific listing. (Relationship: Item 1:N Conversation)

transactionId.description: Optional: Reference to a Transaction if the conversation is related to an ongoing or past borrow. (Relationship: Transaction 1:N Conversation)

lastMessage.description: The last message content in the conversation.

lastMessageAt.description: The date and time of the last message in the conversation, used for sorting.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a conversation between users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

conversationId.description: Reference to the Conversation this message belongs to. (Relationship: Conversation 1:N Message)

senderId.description: Reference to the User who sent this message. (Relationship: User 1:N Message)

participantUserIds.description: Array of participant UIDs, denormalized from parent Conversation.

content.description: The textual content of the message.

sentAt.description: The date and time when the message was sent.

isRead.description: Indicates if the recipient has read the message.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents an in-app notification for a user regarding various events.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who receives this notification. (Relationship: User 1:N Notification)

message.description: The content or message displayed in the notification.

relatedEntityId.description: Optional: Reference to a related entity (e.g., transactionId, conversationId) that the notification pertains to.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the notification was created.

isRead.description: Indicates if the user has read or viewed the notification.
